what: The review card cells (3×2) each swap to another review that is not currently visible, at random 4~8s intervals. The leaving text floats in place and exits 6px up with 4px blur, the new text rises from 6px below with 4px blur, and the two cross over (.45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)). A hovered (focused) cell does not change, and the other cells recede to .7 in .2s. Pressing the pause button stops them all and the label changes to Play again. Swaps happen only while on screen.

options.min · max: Interval range that varies per cell (seconds), default 4 · 8
options.dim: Opacity of cells not hovered, default .7
options.[data-fx-part=slot]: Slot — review whose first child is currently showing
options.[data-fx-part=pool]: <template> — The remaining reviews not in the cells (each child is one review)
options.[data-fx-part=pause]: Pause button — two texts in data-on and data-off (Pause testimonials · Resume testimonials)

use: …
note: With reduced motion on, hide the pause button instead of changing anything

from.where: index.html .m-wall (Trusted by teams testimonial wall 3×2 · Pause testimonials)
